discovery: Development of next-generation DNA sequencing by synthesis (massively parallel sequencing using reversible-terminator chemistry and cluster amplification)
rationale: Sequencing-by-synthesis is fundamentally a chemical invention (fluorescent reversible terminators, surface cluster chemistry) with enormous impact across biology and medicine. It has already won the Breakthrough Prize (2022) and Millennium Technology Prize (2020), which often come before a Nobel. It also follows the committee's recent preference for chemistry tools that transform the life sciences, and it does not overlap with the 2024 (protein design/structure) or 2025 (MOFs) prizes.
